plan.title: SRC-SCH-019 Fixed Technical End with RFQ Duration

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Configure the required Technical and RFQ stages.
Apply a template to the Technical stage.
Add the required product line item to the project.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage create screen, set the schedule End time mode to Fixed time, choose a valid fixed end time, save the schedule, and stop with the Technical stage showing the saved fixed end-time configuration

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated create-screen step for setting a fixed end time, so perform this specific schedule configuration directly on screen.
Apply a pricing template to the RFQ stage.
Set the RFQ stage to a 60-minute duration.
Invite a QA test vendor so the event has participants.
Attempt publishing and assert the app's refusal/message for the fixed Technical end time versus the RFQ duration comparison defect.
